# Uppio

> Hosting for the web apps a coding agent builds: static, PHP, Python or Node with MariaDB. No sign-up: the agent starts an account itself, and its human keeps the apps through a claim link.

The agent documentation, always current: https://api.madeyour.app/llms.txt

- Docs for people: https://uppio.dev/docs/
- Plans: https://uppio.dev/pricing/
- Terms: https://uppio.dev/legal/terms/
- Contact: hello@uppio.dev
